intro.text: Nanha Relina, a woman of Hearthstone.

items.text: In 1166 a thirteen-year-old Kaladin overheard her gossiping with Terith outside the bakery. They called Lirin's skill as a surgeon unnatural and suggested he had stolen a goblet of spheres from Brightlord Wistiow with a forged will. Seeing that Kaladin had heard, they fled into the bakery.
